name: include-what-you-use
description_en: A tool for use with clang to analyze #includes in C and C++ source files
readme_excerpt: Include What You Use # For more in-depth documentation, see docs. Instructions for users ## "Include what you use" means this: for every symbol (type, function, variable, or macro) that you use in foo.cc (or foo.cpp), either foo.cc or foo.h should include a .h file that exports the declaration of that symbol.
